QuestInfo.name: [Water Wars] Cygnus Knights Hydroblaster Training 2
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Kizan and participate in the Cygnus Knights Hydroblaster tutorial for the Water Wars event.
QuestInfo.1: You talked to Kizan and participated in the Cygnus Knights Hydroblaster tutorial. Use the Bubble Gun you purchased to shoot the Resistance team's Water Warrior.
QuestInfo.2: You participated in Kizan's Hydroblaster tutorial and used your Bubble Blaster to shoot the Resistance Team's Water Warrior. \r\nYou learned that you can receive various stackable buffs when struck by different Hydroblasters. You also learned that firing a Hydroblaster requires #t3996112#. #t3996112# can be purchased from Mihile, and can be obtained through daily quests and hunting monsters.

default.0: Use the 'Bubble Blaster' to attack the Resistance Team's Water Warrior!
